name: killi-and-milli
description: A co-op arcade maze game about two pufferfish. The game is index.html; everything else is tooling.

scripts.test: npm run test:quick && npm run test:gameplay
scripts.test:quick: node tests/scoring.js && node tests/ads.js && node tests/fish.js && node tests/creatures.js && node tests/bosses.js && node tests/unlocks.js && node tests/lookandsound.js && node tests/paper-look.js
scripts.wiki: node tools/wiki/wikiassets.js && node tests/bosses.js && node tests/fish.js && python3 tools/wiki/wiki_gen.py && node tests/wiki.js
